newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian dlr deadlocked as confusion reigns.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian dlr deadlocked as confusion reigns.

text.p: The Australian dollar idled in a five tick range at the midsession as the local market shunned the currency following Thursday's wild excesses.

Traders said the market was more than a little confused by the price action which saw the dollar leap to test US$0.7680, crash to 76 cents and then bounce back to US$0.7650 offshore. Many lost money in both directions and were reluctant to take positions until a clearer trend emerged.
They may have a while to wait as the lessened risk of a rate cut had attracted strong support at 76 cents while Japanese investors had a yen to dump long A$ positions on every rally.
By 12.15 pm (0115 GMT) the local dollar was flat out at US$0.7645/50, exactly where it started the day, having recovered from US$0.7610/15 overnight.

Analysts said the medium term direction would be set by which broke first, US$0.7585 or US$0.7735 and would likely yield a move of at least a cent. Some felt the risk/reward favoured the upside since the bear target of 75 was only a cent away while the potential for recovery stretched all the way to 80.
The currency held broadly firm on the crosses at 94.612/71 yen from 94.24/34 and 58.5 in trade weighted terms from 58.4.
